title: Tanzania's UNESCO World Heritage Sites
excerpt: Tanzania has several UNESCO World Heritage Sites, from the Serengeti to Stone Town and ancient rock art.
body:
## Natural sites

- **Serengeti National Park**
- **Ngorongoro Conservation Area** (mixed natural and cultural)
- **Kilimanjaro National Park**
- **Selous Game Reserve**

## Cultural sites

- **Stone Town of Zanzibar**
- **Ruins of Kilwa Kisiwani and Songo Mnara**
- **Kondoa Rock-Art Sites**

## Visiting

Several of these lie on classic routes. Others, like Kondoa, require more planning.

See [Stone Town](/blog/stone-town-walking-guide/), [Kilwa](/blog/kilwa-kisiwani-ruins/) and [Ngorongoro](/blog/ngorongoro-crater-guide/). [Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
